proposal.summary: Microweber <=1.2.15 allows account takeover by registering an account with a victim's email, then logging in via an OAuth provider using that same email to take over the victim's account.
proposal.cwe_quote: Oauth Misconfiguration Leads To Account Takeover.

AV.quote: When the victim tries to login with default Oauth providers like Google, Github, Microsoft, Twitter, Linkedin, Telegram or Facebook etc(auth login) with that same e-mail id that we created account before, via this way we can take over the victim's account with the recently created login credentials.

PR.quote:
Create an account with the victim's email address.

Register endpoint: https://target-website.com/register#

UI.quote: When the victim tries to login with default Oauth providers like Google, Github, Microsoft, Twitter, Linkedin, Telegram or Facebook etc(auth login) with that same e-mail id that we created account before, via this way we can take over the victim's account with the recently created login credentials.

C.quote: we can take over the victim's account with the recently created login credentials.

I.quote: we can take over the victim's account with the recently created login credentials.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm reproduction steps against an instance: register an account using a victim email, then perform OAuth login with that email to observe whether the site links the attacker-controlled account to the victim's existing account; collect exact requests/responses and vendor-config settings responsible for linking by email.
